name: Iron City Comic Con
blurb: A comics and pop-culture convention at the Birmingham Jefferson Convention Complex, with celebrity guests, cosplay contests and wrestling stars.
notes: The seed's 'May 30-31, 2026' date already ran and is in the past as of this 2026-10-05 check: the Guests page's own panel-schedule graphics are headed 'PANEL SCHEDULE SATURDAY, MAY 30TH' / 'SUNDAY, MAY 31ST' and one graphic's footer explicitly reads 'SATURDAY, MAY 30, 2026' / 'East Hall'. A third-party aggregator (Eventeny) lists 'May 22 & 23, 2027', but RESEARCH.md directs using the con's own site over aggregators, and the official site does not corroborate that specific date, so it is not used.
